title: YouTube Web 0.2.0
notes:
First GitHub release of YouTube Web, a standalone Open Voyah Controls companion that opens mobile YouTube on the head unit.

- Uses the system WebView without requiring Google Play services. Supports full-screen video, media buttons, and playback controls in the Open Voyah Controls media widget.
- Adds its own launcher tile and pauses playback when its window is hidden. Open Voyah Controls can set the companion's display, window width, and interface scale.
- A progress line shows page loading. The optional startup animation can be skipped with a tap and disabled in the app's settings.
- Check for new releases and download signed updates in the same settings screen.

Install **YouTubeWeb-v0.2.0.apk** on the head unit. Requires Android 9 or later, Android System WebView 80 or newer, and an internet connection. A debug preview signed with a different certificate requires a reinstall.
